Uses
Good-quality fresh peppers should be
firm and brightly colored.  Sweet peppers
can be stored unwashed in plastic bags
in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

Most varieties of peppers can be eaten
either raw or cooked.  Sweet peppers
frequently are julienned or chopped and
added raw to salads or  cooked in soups,
stews, and stir-fries.  They also can be
roasted (which makes it easy to remove
the skin and adds smoky flavor) and mar-
inated, or they may be stuffed and baked
